root_cause: regression shipped by the v2.8 deployment of checkout-service: the new build leaks pooled database connections, and the pool saturates once the release is live

evidence.supports: a release landed during the incident
the failures belong to the newly deployed build
the pool saturates as the leaked connections accumulate
the connection acquisitions that never completed

ruled_out: a standing connection leak unrelated to any release - deployment appears in the window and both db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked carry version=v2.8
inventory-service internal error - dependency_error is only x3 with status=409 while db_pool_usage reached 0.789
memory leak - memory_mb went 91.8 to 96.0 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
